items.title: DeepMind mapped every possible DNA mutation
items.oneliner: DeepMind shipped 9 billion variant predictions in a 1 petabyte atlas. Biology now has a foundation model dataset.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra aced Korea's CSAT
items.oneliner: GPT-6 Astra reportedly got a perfect score on Korea's toughest exam. Benchmark theater is becoming labor market signal.

items.title: An AI-designed drug hit aging biomarkers
items.oneliner: Insilico's Nature study says rentosertib improved six proteomic aging clocks. AI drug discovery now has a human datapoint.

items.title: LG TVs reportedly monitored users in standby
items.oneliner: LG TVs allegedly scanned Wi-Fi and logged audio even offline. Edge devices keep proving privacy defaults are fiction.

items.title: DHS reportedly used financial surveillance for stops
items.oneliner: A DHS unit reportedly flagged drivers using financial behavior. Predictive policing keeps drifting from analytics into probable cause laundering.

items.title: A 1990s certificate authority key was factored
items.oneliner: A hobbyist factored a 512-bit CA key from the 1990s. Legacy crypto debt remains exploitable with modest compute.

items.title: Police are reacting to camera glasses
items.oneliner: US police are warning officers about Meta smart glasses. Wearable recording is colliding with old assumptions about controlled spaces.

items.title: Mistral raised 3 billion euros
items.oneliner: Mistral raised 3 billion euros to push sovereign open-weight AI. Europe is funding independence, not just another chatbot.

items.title: Qwen 27B held up at 4-bit
items.oneliner: Qwen3.8 27B kept benchmark performance at 4-bit in 17 GB RAM. Local deployment economics just got more practical.

items.title: Cloudflare dominates Europe's CDN layer
items.oneliner: Cloudflare fronts nearly 90 percent of European CDN users. Internet resilience now depends on fewer companies than most teams admit.
